M8 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
Nine cell lines. The ridge fits 101 annotation dims from EIGHT training lines, so
it is underdetermined by construction and lambda is doing most of the work; the
inner leave-one-line-out picks it honestly but cannot manufacture degrees of
freedom. A FAIL here does not prove annotation is uninformative in general -- it
proves it is not learnable from eight examples in this form.
s_c is a DIAGONAL scaling. It is the exact object loop 259's branches spanned, but
it cannot express a rotation, and a genuinely off-diagonal interaction would be
invisible to every number here.
s_c* for the held-out line is fitted on that line's own residual, so the oracle
is an upper bound that no honest model can reach, not a target to aim at.
978 landmarks and shRNA, not a transcriptome and not a clean knockout, and every
number lives under loop 254's construct ceiling.
